        "The backend and importer use synchronous localized defaults; the duplicate warning uses asynchronous formatting followed by a modal prompt. Commit-message claims of nonblocking UI are not measured or established.",
        "UI fragments move label/accesskey roles into Fluent attributes. Dynamic tag names use with/without-accesskey messages, first9 numeric accesskeys, and menu accelerator hints; remove-all becomes a separate static message with0 accesskey. Numeric keyset choice is scoped, not a global localization rule.",
        "The migration script maps old DTD/property values and positional placeholders to Fluent variables; no migration engine, locale archive, docs or runtime run.",
        "Removing default description preference registrations is separate from deleting user preferences; no user-pref deletion body is added by this diff.",
        "All779 owned diff lines/20paths read. Current dynamic builders preserve original index positions across skipped autotags; only positions1–9 receive numeric accesskeys. Main menus also set acceltext. Keyset keeps shift-any for shifted numeric layouts. These are scoped tag contracts, not a global shortcut localization rule.",
        "SetupLabelTags returns early for version>1, otherwise localizes and writes five defaults sequentially then stores version2. Constructor ignores its return before RefreshKeyCache. Importer instead preserves customized old labels by matching both current color and localized default name before replacement. No atomic migration or universal locale/profile result.",
        "The removed static gMigratingKeys was initializedfalse; a complete same-file reference check found only four conditional uses. Their lowercasing remains unconditional in the new source. This does not prove all callers or stored-key contracts unchanged.",
        "No changed tests/assertions. Selected accepted checkTagItems directly asserts label/accesskey/value/color/checked/no-extra-item state; selected handleNewTagDialog directly asserts initial focus and empty input before filling/accepting. These selected helper messages are nonempty; their limited scope does not directly test duplicate-warning rejection or all locales. No test ran.",
        "The actual LocalizeMessage helper and public lesson already exist and are reused with original timestamps. The published snippet omits finalLF and blob metadata; separate checked identity remains qualified. Actual initialization/import callers and resource consumers are freshly inspected. No engine, per-locale migration, rendering, build, lint or native runtime validation.",
        "At the source-only stage, original Bug2043522/D303294 context was not yet reconciled. Parent has now read and joined both complete originals below. The separate regression2045479 and paired engine dependency scopes remain open.",
        "Parent reconciled the complete saved original Bug2043522 current0–2/activity/footer and D303294 creation-to-close timeline, all5actual inline bodies including one literal suggestion. No fresh browser navigation or fabricated missing discussion; original collectors/times/IDs retained.",
        "The reviewer asked why only one tag-label path checked the key element. The final owned diff uses computed numeric positions in both paths rather than retaining that key lookup. A further attribute-based built-in-tag refactor was only suggested as a larger follow-up and is not claimed adopted.",
        "The literal inline request adds a period to the accelerator-hint comment; both owned final diff and accepted current source contain it. This supports the concrete scoped request/outcome only. Approval and Done alone were not used as adoption proof.",
        "A l10n reviewer explicitly accepted non-translator-modifiable numeric shortcuts with a reservation about past locale changes. Two humans reported Pontoon/archive checks. These are historical reported checks, not our own exhaustive locale inspection or a global instruction about localization.",
        "The summary claims improved responsiveness and seamless migration. Actual code establishes async formatting followed by a modal prompt, sequential defaults and guarded import only. Historical remote-build completions and Try link are not fresh tests and linked artifacts were not opened. Regression2045479 remains a separate unread dependency, not a required primary gap for this row."
